events.title: Update 9: Next Fest, a Linux demo, the Wardrobe and lots of fixes v0.9.4.17
events.summary: Hi everyone and welcome to Next Fest! If you are new here: Prigod Idle is an idle Autobattler-RPG where you can get a lot of cool loot, from which you create cool builds to defeat a variety of different enemies! The demo is already live and the full game comes out on 4th November, so it is only 2 weeks from now! If you played before, welcome back!ImprovementsYou can now change how your gear looks like if you buy the wardrobe!The demo now has a native Linux version, as a few of you asked for it.

events.title: Update 3 - Full idle mode, tech trees reworked and a release date
events.summary: Development is going on nicely, thank you for all your feedback. This is a bigger post than the last two. Auto-run turns Prigod Idle into a full idle game, every tech tree is drawn as an actual tree, six screens were rebuilt, the loading times got reduced massively and there is a long list of fixes and balance changes from your reports.While some of these changes will only effect the full game later, most of these changes are already available for you in the demo!And also: We have a release date

events.title: The free demo is out now!
events.summary: Hi! I am Nicolas, the solo developer behind Prigod Idle. As of today you can download the free demo directly from the store page. What is in the demo- The first ten stages of the campaign, roughly 2-3 hours of play- The full core loop: your hero fights automatically, and every win is set up by your decisions. Gear, abilities, upgrades and idle generators with offline progress- The real start of the game. Everything beyond you can't unlock now will be in the final version, releasing soon! Be read
